# AI Design Skills — landing-page-design

A vendored, unmodified copy of the landing-page-design skill from
[elayadesign/ai-design-skills](https://github.com/elayadesign/ai-design-skills)
(MIT). It is used by the `brand-launch` theme to give the generator a
conversion-first structure and a strict visual system for marketing pages.

- `skills/landing-page-design/SKILL.md` — the upstream skill, byte-for-byte.
- `LICENSE` — upstream MIT license (Copyright (c) 2026 Elaya).
- `UPSTREAM.md` — pinned commit, copied files and SHA-256 digests.

Stitchcraft does not modify this file. The registry selects it as
`landing-page-design`; other themes do not load it.
